title: @types/react-virtualized-auto-sizer is deprecated
summary: npm marks @types/react-virtualized-auto-sizer as deprecated: "This is a stub types definition. react-virtualized-auto-sizer provides its own type definitions, so you do not need this installed."

constraints: @types/react-virtualized-auto-sizer only declares types; react-virtualized-auto-sizer now ships its own declarations, so no conflicting ambient definition may remain.

steps.title: Remove the stub types package
steps.instructions: Remove @types/react-virtualized-auto-sizer from devDependencies and any explicit reference to it, such as a tsconfig.json compilerOptions.types entry.

steps.title: Use the bundled declarations
steps.instructions: Keep react-virtualized-auto-sizer on a version that ships its own type definitions and import its types from react-virtualized-auto-sizer.
